body.purpose: Default UI voice — labels, menus, descriptions (Caveat). Deliberately the hand-drawn face.

work.purpose: Dense settings and forms where scanning speed matters (Inter).

mono.purpose: Numeric values meant to be read, typed, or compared (JetBrains Mono).

shadows.name: node-rest
shadows.purpose: Default lift of a node off the paper. Blur radius is always 0.

shadows.name: menu-lifted
shadows.purpose: Context menus, dragging nodes, raised surfaces.

shadows.name: sketch-button
shadows.purpose: Inked buttons and cards — a hard ink shadow in the line color.

shadows.name: port-connected-glow
shadows.purpose: The one allowed soft glow — signals a live connection, which is meaning not decoration.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, press, port scale — the physical feel of a control.

motion.name: transition-normal
motion.purpose: Default state transitions on buttons and panels.

motion.name: transition-slow
motion.purpose: Larger reveals; kept organic, never choreographed page-loads.

motion.name: press-lift
motion.value: translateY(-2px) on hover, translateY(1px) on active
motion.purpose: The Press-Is-Physical rule: shadow grows on lift, shrinks on press.

components.name: Node
components.description: The signature surface: a hand-drawn white card on dot-grid paper, draggable from its header. Used as-is or opened (press e) to rewire its insides.
components.html: Samplerinstrument
components.css: .ds-node { display: inline-block; min-width: 180px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #1A1A1A; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1); font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; color: #1A1A1A; transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-node:hover { box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-node-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 16px; background: #EDE8E0; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4CFC6; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; cursor: grab; } .ds-node-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; } .ds-node-type { font-size: 16px; color: #8A8A8A; } .ds-node-body { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-node-label { font-size: 16px; color: #8A8A8A; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled primary action. Lifts on hover (to walnut), depresses on click — a physical sticker press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; color: #FFFFFF; background: #1A1A1A; border: 2px solid #1A1A1A; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 14px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #1A1A1A; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6B5B4F; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1A1A1A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #1A1A1A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A1A1A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Node Button
components.description: Default white button inside a node. Fills with sand on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-node { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; color: #1A1A1A; background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #1A1A1A; border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-node:hover { background: #E8E3DA; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-node:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A1A1A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Numeric Input
components.description: Exact numeric field — monospace, because the value is meant to be read and typed precisely.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; color: #1A1A1A; background: #F5F0E8; border: 2px solid #1A1A1A; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; width: 96px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #6B5B4F; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A1A1A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Port
components.description: A typed connection point. Audio is blue, control is grey; the color IS the legend. Hover scales up; a live connection glows.
components.css: .ds-port { display: inline-block; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #1A1A1A; cursor: crosshair; transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-port:hover { transform: scale(1.25); } .ds-port-audio { background: #4A90C2; } .ds-port-audio:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 8px #5B9FD4; } .ds-port-control { background: #808080; margin-left: 8px; }

narrative.overview: OpenJammer looks like a sketchbook that makes sound. The canvas is warm paper printed with a faint dot grid; nodes are hand-drawn boxes in Caveat's friendly line, bordered in ink and lifted off the page by hard, blur-free shadows like stickers pressed onto a notebook. It is deliberately not a piece of pro-audio equipment. The system is crafted, immediate, and deep: a beginner is making sound in seconds, and the same warm surface lets an expert drop inside a node and rewire its guts. There is no ceiling. The aesthetic carries the product's two beliefs — perception is the medium, and a minimal core is made infinite by everyone, including the look, which is pure CSS variables anyone can reskin.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dot-grid paper canvas; nodes are hand-drawn ink boxes on white.
Caveat (hand-drawn) is the voice; Inter does the dense work; JetBrains Mono means exact.
Hard, blur-free offset shadows — stickers on paper, never soft ambient glow.
2px ink borders and generously rounded corners (6-20px) on everything.
Port color is meaning: audio is blue, control is grey, universal is violet.
Three themes (Cream default, Cyberpunk, Midnight Blue) re-map the same token roles.

rules.name: The Port-Color-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Port and cable color is never decoration. Blue means audio, grey means control, violet means universal — the type is the source of truth and the color follows. Do not spend these colors on anything that isn't a port or a cable.

rules.name: The Signal-Not-Brand Rule
rules.body: Pine/ochre/clay report machine state and always travel with a label or icon. Ink and walnut are the brand. Never style a heading or a surface in a state color.

rules.name: The Caveat-Is-the-Voice Rule
rules.body: The hand-drawn face is the identity; it is allowed in UI labels and buttons here precisely because the sketchbook is the product. It is the only display font allowed, and it never sets exact data.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Exact Rule
rules.body: If a value is monospace, it can be copied, typed, or compared character by character. Never use mono for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Hard-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows never blur. box-shadow blur radius is always 0. Depth is an offset, not a glow. A blurred shadow anywhere in this system is a bug.

rules.name: The Press-Is-Physical Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements lift on hover (translateY -1 to -2px with a larger offset shadow) and depress on click (translateY 1px with a smaller shadow), so a control feels like a real object being pressed.

dos: Do keep shadows hard and blur-free (2px 3px 0, blur radius 0). Depth is an offset.
Do make controls feel physical: lift on hover, depress on click, shadow growing and shrinking.
Do use Caveat for the voice, Inter for dense data, and JetBrains Mono for exact numeric values only.
Do color ports and cables strictly by type: audio = blue, control = grey, universal = violet.
Do keep the depth there but out of the way — a beginner sees a simple node; the expert presses e to go inside.
Do keep every accent reskinnable: all color is CSS variables, so any user can build a high-contrast or color-blind-safe theme without forking.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no flat corporate cards, no hero-metric tiles, no cool-grey chrome.
Don't drift into sterile pro-DAW chrome — dense joyless grey, engineer-first density for its own sake.
Don't make it a toy: hand-drawn must read as crafted and trustworthy, not cute.
Don't reach for the sci-fi / AI-tool cliché: no glassmorphism, no glowing gradients, no neon-on-black as a default.
Don't add a blurred box-shadow anywhere. If it has a blur radius, it's wrong.
Don't use a state color (pine/ochre/clay) to style a heading, button, or surface.
Don't put a display font on exact data, or spend wiring colors on anything that isn't a port or a cable.
Don't ever present a wall — no pro ceiling, no dead end. The instrument is infinitely deep.
